Assumptions and formula

For each new monthly cohort, GBP setup and first-month commission arrive in the acquisition month plus collection delay; its second-month commission arrives one month later. Other recurring services pay setup and month-one components in the acquisition month plus delay. Websites pay their one-time pool after the initial deposit is fully collected, assumed in the acquisition month plus delay. Collection percentage is a probability-weighted forecast of full eligible receipts, not authorization for partial-deposit payout. Annual = sum of months 1–12, not month 12 × 12. Late cohorts can spill into year 2.

Services & pricing

Blank prices mean unverified and block new deal creation. GBP plan 3 includes one social channel and two posts per week. Prices are not assumed to be approved.

Historical GBP drafts were $149 and $249, not confirmed offers. The active calculator now uses editable DEMO proposals: $300 setup and monthly $299 / $399 / $599. These are not the historical prices or approved JML prices. That draft included basic optimization for a verified profile without a separate setup fee, which conflicts with the new setup-fee model. Current public GBP pricing is under review. The original third-tier price is unknown; its $599 is a test proposal. Admin can change all example amounts. Proposed setup: SEO $990; social $299; paid ads $499. Website setup is included in its project price, default separate setup $0 to avoid double charging. These are proposals, not approved JML prices.
Service / planOriginal setup $Monthly / project $Term / one-time commissionStatus / scope

GBP commission rules

Default 50% original setup minus the discount dollar for dollar, floored at zero. Maximum setup discount stays fixed at 50% of original setup. Month 3 commission is zero. Minimum customer term is three months; collection is not guaranteed.

Other services · one-time early commission

Configure each service in the pricing table. Recurring services default to 50% of discounted setup plus 50% of month one, each tied to its corresponding collected receipt. Partial collections allocate proportionally. No commission on later monthly fees or uncollected future contract value. Website defaults to 8% of project price, once after the first deposit is fully collected, subject to margin/legal review.

Current public JML SEO and paid ads pages describe month-to-month arrangements. The six-month SEO minimum requested here and proposed three-month paid term are changes to that public offer, NOT verified current terms. Admin must resolve and approve client terms before real quoting.

SEO/AEO minimum six months is user-requested. Social and paid ads initial three-month terms are proposals. Website is a project, not a monthly commitment; its term input is unused.

Forecast probabilities

Planning assumptions only. Weighted forecast = remaining uncollected potential commission × stage probability. Signed does not mean paid.

Data is stored only in this browser's local storage and your exported file. There is no server, cloud sync, external signup or payment processing. Local storage is not encrypted and does not protect data from other users of this browser. Keep real client data out of this prototype.
